newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Citibank exec named Bank of Boston chief in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Citibank exec named Bank of Boston chief in Brazil.

text.p: Bank of Boston Corp's Brazil unit said it has hired as its new president Carlos Craide, an executive director at Citicorp's Citibank Brazil subsidiary.
Craide will replace Henrique Meirelles, who will take over as Bank of Boston president and chief operating officer on Oct 4, the bank said in a statement.

Craide, 49, is currently executive director of Corporate Banking and Products at Citibank Brazil, where he has worked for 22 years, it said. Between 1994 and 1995, Craide worked in Citibank's headquarters in New York, the statement added.
